summary_en: 500,000 shares (7.35% of shares outstanding ex-treasury) up to ¥1,600M. Execution window Aug 12, 2026 to May 31, 2027. Method: open-market purchase via ToSTNeT-3. Price ceiling not disclosed.
title_en: Notice Regarding Determination of Matters Relating to Acquisition of Treasury Shares
translation_en_brief: Enomoto Co., Ltd. (Code 6928, TSE Standard) announced on August 10, 2026 a buyback authorization approved by the Board. The company will acquire up to 500,000 shares (7.35% of shares outstanding excluding treasury) for a maximum expenditure of ¥1,600 million. Execution will take place from August 12, 2026 through May 31, 2027 via open-market purchase on the Tokyo Stock Exchange under a ToSTNeT-3 trading agreement. The company stated that although its future earnings potential is high, current share price levels (with price-to-book ratio below 1.0x) undervalue the company's intrinsic worth. The buyback is intended to demonstrate management's clear intent to accelerate shareholder returns, enhance capital efficiency (ROE), and drive early correction of the PBR to 1.0x or above. The company noted that its business foundation and earnings power remain extremely robust, with FY2027 (year ending March 2027) results tracking well, supporting the final-year targets of the current mid-term plan "Vision 2030 2nd STEP."
